analyzeSpectrum() Adımları:
1. Known Molecule Validation
• localStorage kontrolü
• Peak karşılaştırma (±0.3 ppm)
• Mixture detection
2. Library Search (Local)
• 794 moleküllü kütüphane
• Tolerance: ±0.15 ppm
• Solvent correction
• Frequency normalization
3. PubChem Integration
• searchPubChem()
• NMR data extraction
4. AI Analysis (Gemini/ChatGPT)
• Structural elucidation
• FTIR prediction
• Confidence scoring
5. Result Processing
• Enhanced library update
• localStorage caching

div.div:
GET /api/pubchem
Parameters:
• type: 'name' | 'cid' | 'formula' | 'nmr'
• query: search string
Workflow (type=name):
1. Name → CID lookup
REST: /pug/compound/name/{name}/cids/JSON
2. Parallel NMR check (max 3 CIDs)
REST: /pug_view/data/compound/{cid}/JSON
Section: '1D NMR Spectra'
Subsection: '1H NMR Spectra'
Data: 'Shifts [ppm]:Intensity'
3. Molecule properties
REST: /pug/compound/cid/{cid}/property/
MolecularFormula,Title/JSON
4. Enhanced library search
• Local JSON file
• Name/formula matching
Response:
{ success, molecules[], total,
searched, foundWithNMR }

div.div:
searchMoleculeLibrary()
Algorithm:
1. Load library (794 molecules)
2. Get solvent-corrected peaks
3. For each molecule:
• Match user peaks
• Match library peaks
• Calculate coverage
• Score = weighted average
4. Filter by threshold (75%)
5. Sort by score DESC
getPeaksForConditions()
• Solvent shift correction
• Frequency normalization
• Temperature compensation
Tolerance: ±0.15 ppm
Data Source:
• lib/data/moleculeLibrary.ts
• Categories: organic acids,
alcohols, ketones, amines,
aromatics, etc.

div.div:
Kimyasal Kayma (δ, ppm):
• Elektronik çevre etkisi
• Shielding/Deshielding
• Referans: TMS (0 ppm)
Karakteristik Bölgeler:
• 0-2 ppm: Alifatik C-H (alkil)
• 2-3 ppm: α-carbonyl, N-CH
• 3-4 ppm: O-CH (eter, alkol)
• 4-6 ppm: Vinylic, allyl
• 6-8 ppm: Aromatic H
• 9-10 ppm: Aldehyde H
• 10-13 ppm: Carboxylic acid H
Multiplicity (Spin-Spin Coupling):
• Singlet (s): n=0 komşu
• Doublet (d): n=1
• Triplet (t): n=2
• Quartet (q): n=3
• Multiplet (m): karmaşık
• n+1 rule
Integration:
• Peak alanı ∝ H sayısı
• Normalize edilir
Coupling Constants (J, Hz):
• ³J(vicinal): 6-8 Hz
• ²J(geminal): 12-15 Hz
• ⁴J(long range): 0-3 Hz

div.div:
Residual Solvent Peaks:
DMSO-d₆:
• Residual: 2.50 ppm (quintet)
• Water: 3.33 ppm
CDCl₃:
• Residual: 7.26 ppm (singlet)
• Water: 1.56 ppm
D₂O:
• HDO: 4.79 ppm (variable)
• pH dependent
Solvent Shift Effects:
• Aromatic solvent ring current
• H-bonding interactions
• Polarity effects
Correction Algorithm:
δ_corrected = δ_obs + Δδ_solvent

div.div:
Wavenumber (ν̃, cm⁻¹):
ν̃ = 1/λ = ν/c
Fonksiyonel Grup Frekansları:
O-H stretch:
• Alkol: 3200-3600 cm⁻¹ (broad)
• Carboxylic acid: 2500-3300 cm⁻¹ (very broad)
N-H stretch:
• Primary amine: 3300-3500 cm⁻¹ (2 peaks)
• Secondary amine: 3300-3500 cm⁻¹ (1 peak)
• Amide: 3100-3500 cm⁻¹
C-H stretch:
• Aliphatic: 2850-3000 cm⁻¹
• Aromatic: 3000-3100 cm⁻¹
• Aldehyde: 2720-2820 cm⁻¹ (2 peaks)
C=O stretch:
• Ketone: 1705-1725 cm⁻¹ (strong)
• Aldehyde: 1720-1740 cm⁻¹
• Ester: 1735-1750 cm⁻¹
• Carboxylic acid: 1700-1725 cm⁻¹
• Amide (I): 1630-1690 cm⁻¹
C=C stretch:
• Aromatic: 1450-1600 cm⁻¹ (multiple)
• Alkene: 1620-1680 cm⁻¹
C-O stretch:
• Alcohol, ether, ester: 1000-1300 cm⁻¹
Aromatic C-H bend:
• Out-of-plane: 650-900 cm⁻¹
• Substitution pattern indicator
Fingerprint Region:
• 400-1500 cm⁻¹
• Molecule-specific

div.div:
Sistematik Yaklaşım:
1. Moleküler Formül Belirleme
• Elemental analysis
• Mass spectrometry
• Degree of unsaturation:
DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2
2. Fonksiyonel Grup Tespiti
• FTIR karakteristik pikler
• Diagnostic regions
3. ¹H NMR Analizi
• Peak sayısı → H tipleri
• Integration → H sayıları
• Multiplicity → komşuluk
• Chemical shift → elektron çevre
4. Parça Birleştirme
• Substructure identification
• Connectivity determination
• COSY, HSQC data (if available)
5. Yapı Doğrulama
• Tüm NMR peaks explained?
• FTIR consistent?
• Stereochemistry?
• Literature comparison
AI-Assisted Method:
• Pattern recognition
• Database matching
• Probability scoring
• Alternative structures

div.div:
Algorithm (librarySearch.ts):
function matchPeaks(userPeaks, libPeaks, tolerance):
matched_user = 0
matched_lib = 0
for each user_peak in userPeaks:
if exists lib_peak where:
|user_peak.shift - lib_peak.shift| ≤ tolerance
then:
matched_user++
for each lib_peak in libPeaks:
if exists user_peak where:
|lib_peak.shift - user_peak.shift| ≤ tolerance
then:
matched_lib++
coverage = (matched_user / userPeaks.length) * 0.6 +
(matched_lib / libPeaks.length) * 0.4
return coverage * 100 // percentage
Tolerance: ±0.15 ppm (strict)
Threshold: 75% minimum match

div.div:
1. Spectroscopic Validation:
• All peaks accounted for
• Integration ratios correct
• Coupling patterns consistent
• Chemical shifts reasonable
2. Structural Validation:
• Molecular formula matches
• Functional groups present
• Stereochemistry possible
• No forbidden structures
3. Database Cross-Reference:
• PubChem CID lookup
• Literature NMR comparison
• Known compound verification
4. AI Confidence Scoring:
• 90-100%: High confidence
• 75-90%: Moderate confidence
• 50-75%: Low confidence
• <50%: Unreliable
5. Mixture Detection:
• Extra peaks present?
• Integration anomalies?
• Multiple molecular sources?
6. Known Molecule Enforcement:
• localStorage cache
• Force structure if >95% match
• Detailed peak assignment

div.div:
Common Issues:
• Solvent peaks misidentified
→ Auto-detection and filtering
• Integration errors
→ Normalize to smallest
• Overlapping peaks
→ Deconvolution needed
• Impurities present
→ Threshold filtering
• AI hallucination
→ Multi-model consensus
→ Database validation
→ Confidence scoring
• API failures
→ Retry logic
→ Fallback providers
→ Cached results
